articles.title: A Computer That Learns From Old Storms Guessed Right
articles.summary: A computer model that learns from old storms beat older models at guessing Hurricane Isaias's path. Forecasters still mix several models together before warning the public.

articles.title: A Court Said Yes, but a Family Is Still Waiting
articles.summary: A family has waited almost a year for a visa, even after a judge ordered a ban lifted. Lawyers say interviews and visa stamps are still moving slowly.

articles.title: More Forest Land May Not Fix Loggers' Biggest Problems
articles.summary: Opening more national forest land may not fix loggers' biggest problems. High fuel and parts prices, few workers, and slow projects stand in the way.
